summary: tslint-folder-schema preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises itself as a tslint rule and copies the legitimate servicetitan/folder-lint rule source into lib/folderSchemaRule.js, but package.json declares a preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) unrelated to lint functionality. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle with rotated string-array obfuscation (WV8StW shift routine, hex-mangled _0x identifiers, large numeric-literal dictionary) whose contents are not inspectable without full deobfuscation. The lint rule surface serves as cover: installing the package causes an alternate runtime to fetch and execute opaque attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine at npm install time. README is a TODO placeholder and the repository/homepage URLs point at an unrelated legitimate project (servicetitan/folder-lint), consistent with impersonation rather than an authentic release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
